zh-CN.title: 安全快门速度
zh-CN.intro: 安全快门速度计算器依据焦距估算手持不易模糊的快门（防抖可放宽），低于该值易手抖模糊，适合旅行与弱光手持拍摄。

en-US.title: Safe Shutter Speed Calculator
en-US.intro: Find the slowest safe handheld shutter speed from focal length and crop factor, with stops of stabilisation taken into account.

zh-CN.title: 闪光灯指数 GN
zh-CN.intro: 闪光灯指数 GN 计算器由闪光指数与拍摄距离求可用光圈（ISO100），辅助室内或夜景补光的曝光设定，适合外拍布光。

en-US.title: Flash Guide Number (GN) Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate flash guide number, working distance or required aperture from any two of the three values, accounting for ISO and zoom.

zh-CN.title: 景深计算器
zh-CN.intro: 景深计算器依据光圈、焦距与对焦距离求摄影景深、近界与远界及超焦距，适合控制虚化与合焦区域，辅助人像、风光拍摄。

en-US.title: Depth of Field Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate depth of field, near and far focus limits and hyperfocal distance from focal length, aperture, distance and sensor size.

zh-CN.title: 闪光指数计算
zh-CN.intro: 闪光指数计算工具依据闪光指数 GN 与光圈求闪光有效距离（ISO100 标定），适合夜景、人像补光时设定拍摄距离与曝光。

en-US.title: Flash Guide Number Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute flash guide number from distance and aperture, or derive the correct aperture for a given flash-to-subject distance.

zh-CN.title: 等效焦距
zh-CN.intro: 等效焦距计算器求不同画幅下的等效焦距，以全画幅为基准系数 1，方便跨机位视角统一比较与镜头焦段选择。

en-US.title: Equivalent Focal Length Calculator
en-US.intro: Convert focal length between full-frame and crop sensors to compare the effective angle of view of different lenses.

zh-CN.title: 打印分辨率 DPI
zh-CN.intro: 打印分辨率 DPI 计算器由打印尺寸与像素求所需 DPI（300 常用于高质量打印），并反算像素需求，适合冲印与海报输出规划。

en-US.title: Print Resolution (DPI) Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute print resolution in DPI from pixel dimensions and print size, or find the maximum print size at a target DPI.

zh-CN.title: 像素与打印尺寸
zh-CN.intro: 像素与打印尺寸计算器按像素数与 DPI（300 为照片级）求可打印尺寸，反算冲印所需像素，适合海报与照片输出规划。

en-US.title: Pixel to Print Size Reference
en-US.intro: Reference how pixel dimensions map to physical print sizes at common resolutions such as 300 and 150 DPI.

zh-CN.title: ND 滤镜快门换算
zh-CN.intro: ND 滤镜快门换算工具按滤镜档数（如 ND1000 约 10 档）求加滤镜后的延长快门，适合把水流、云彩拍成丝绢状的慢门摄影。

en-US.title: ND Filter Shutter Speed Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate the new shutter speed when adding an ND filter of a given stop value, useful for long-exposure photography.

zh-CN.title: 等效焦距换算
zh-CN.intro: 等效焦距换算工具将 APS-C（约 1.5）、M4/3（约 2.0）等画幅的实际焦距换算为全画幅等效焦距，方便视角统一比较。

en-US.title: Equivalent Focal Length Converter
en-US.intro: Convert a lens focal length between sensor formats using the crop factor to get the equivalent full-frame focal length.

zh-CN.title: 景深 DOF 计算
zh-CN.intro: 景深 DOF 计算器依据光圈、焦距与对焦距离求前景深与后景深范围，适合控制虚化效果与合焦区域，辅助人像、风光摄影。

en-US.title: Depth of Field (DOF) Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate depth of field from focal length, aperture, focus distance and sensor size, giving near and far limits and hyperfocal distance.

zh-CN.title: 日照时长估算
zh-CN.intro: 日照时长估算工具由纬度与赤纬求日出日落日照时长，并标识黄金时刻（日出后/日落前约 1 小时），适合户外摄影与行程规划。

en-US.title: Daylight Duration and Golden Hour Estimator
en-US.h1: Daylight Duration and Golden Hour Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate daylight duration and the golden hour windows for a given date and location to plan outdoor shoots.

zh-CN.title: 对焦超焦距
zh-CN.intro: 对焦超焦距工具计算并应用超焦距对焦时的清晰范围（从 H/2 至无穷远），适合风光摄影最大化景深，辅助对焦距离设定。

en-US.title: Focus Hyperfocal Distance Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate the hyperfocal distance and the range of acceptable sharpness for landscape focusing at a given aperture.

zh-CN.title: 超焦距 H 计算
zh-CN.intro: 超焦距计算器求对焦到超焦距 H 时的景深范围（从 H/2 至无穷远），适合风光与街拍中最大化清晰范围的焦距与对焦设定。

en-US.title: Hyperfocal Distance Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the hyperfocal distance from focal length, aperture and circle of confusion to maximise sharpness from near to infinity.

zh-CN.title: 衍射极限光圈
zh-CN.intro: 衍射极限光圈计算器依据传感器像素密度估算小像素传感器更早遇到衍射极限的光圈值，辅助画质优先的光圈选择。

en-US.title: Diffraction Limit Aperture Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate the aperture at which diffraction begins to limit resolution for a given sensor pixel pitch.

zh-CN.title: 文件大小估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入图像分辨率（像素）、位深与文件格式（RAW/JPEG），工具估算单张照片的存储空间占用，说明 JPEG 因压缩明显小于 RAW，帮助规划存储卡容量与备份策略。

en-US.title: Image File Size Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate image file size from resolution, bit depth and compression ratio before shooting or exporting.

zh-CN.title: 星轨拍摄时长
zh-CN.intro: 星轨拍摄时长计算器按 500 法则估算不出现明显拖线的最长曝光时间，适合星空、星轨摄影的快门设定与地景配合。

en-US.title: Star Trail Exposure Time Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate star trail exposure time from focal length and sensor crop factor to control the length of star trails.

zh-CN.title: 放大倍率
zh-CN.intro: 放大倍率计算器求微距摄影的放大倍率（1:1 表示成像与实物等大），适合微距镜头选型与标本拍摄比例评估。

en-US.title: Magnification Ratio Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate the magnification ratio of a close-up setup from focal length, extension and minimum focus distance.

zh-CN.title: 视角 FOV 计算
zh-CN.intro: 输入镜头焦距与传感器尺寸（全画幅/APS-C 等），工具按几何关系计算画面的水平、垂直与对角线视角（FOV），直观说明传感器越宽、焦距越短视角越大，便于选镜与构图预判。

en-US.title: Field of View (FOV) Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate horizontal, vertical and diagonal field of view from focal length and sensor dimensions.

zh-CN.title: 包围曝光张数
zh-CN.intro: 输入期望的总动态范围与每档曝光步长（如 1 EV、2 EV），工具计算完成 HDR 合成所需的最少包围曝光张数，并提示相邻两张应保留至少 1 EV 重叠，便于拍摄高光暗部细节完整的照片。

en-US.title: Bracketing Frame Count Calculator
en-US.intro: Find the number of bracketing frames needed to cover a given EV range at a chosen exposure step.

zh-CN.title: 微距放大率
zh-CN.intro: 微距放大率计算器依据焦距与物距求放大率（m=1 为等倍），适合微距摄影的标本与像比例评估与镜头选型。

en-US.title: Macro Magnification Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate magnification ratio from focal length and extension tube length, and see the resulting field of view and exposure loss.

zh-CN.title: 曝光值 EV 计算
zh-CN.intro: 曝光值 EV 计算工具由光圈、快门、ISO 求 EV，同场景 EV 恒定，调整三者需保持平衡，适合理解曝光三角与手动模式练习。

en-US.title: Exposure Value (EV) Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate the exposure value from aperture and shutter speed, and find equivalent EV combinations for the same brightness.

zh-CN.title: 摇摄快门速度
zh-CN.intro: 摇摄快门速度计算器估算追随拍摄运动物体时的推荐快门，依据横向速度求可容忍模糊的快门范围，适合体育与生态摄影。

en-US.title: Panning Shutter Speed Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate a suitable panning shutter speed from subject speed, direction and focal length to keep the subject sharp with directional blur.

zh-CN.title: 曝光值 EV
zh-CN.intro: 曝光值 EV 计算器依据光圈、快门与 ISO 求曝光值，EV 越低画面越亮，适合手动曝光、闪光与曝光补偿的量化控制。

en-US.title: Exposure Value (EV) Reference
en-US.intro: Reference common exposure values (EV) for typical lighting scenes and map them to aperture, shutter speed and ISO combinations.

zh-CN.title: 视角计算器
zh-CN.intro: 视角计算器依据传感器尺寸（全画幅 36×24mm）与焦距求镜头水平与垂直视角，适合构图、焦段选择与视野预估。

en-US.title: Angle of View Calculator
en-US.intro: Calculate the angle of view from focal length and sensor size to visualise how much of the scene a lens captures.

zh-CN.title: 动态范围档位
zh-CN.intro: 动态范围档位计算器将亮度比换算为曝光档（stops），评估相机或场景的动态范围，适合 HDR 拍摄与影调控制参考。

en-US.title: Dynamic Range Stops Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate the dynamic range in stops from highlight and shadow limits, and check whether the scene fits the sensor's latitude.

zh-CN.title: RAW 文件大小估算
zh-CN.intro: RAW 文件大小估算工具按像素与位深估算单张 RAW 体积与连续拍摄时长占用空间，适合存储卡、硬盘容量规划与备卡。

en-US.title: RAW File Size Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate RAW file size from sensor resolution and bit depth, with typical compression ratios for common camera formats.

zh-CN.title: 色温换算 mired
zh-CN.intro: 输入光源色温（开尔文）或 mired 微倒数单位之一，工具在两者间互换；摄影中可用 mired 描述滤光片带来的色温偏移量，便于校色与冷暖调补偿时快速选取校正滤镜。

en-US.title: Mired Color Temperature Converter
en-US.intro: Convert between colour temperature (Kelvin) and mired values, and estimate the colour correction filter needed between two light sources.

zh-CN.title: 存储卡可拍张数
zh-CN.intro: 存储卡可拍张数计算器按容量与单张照片大小（RAW 20-50MB/JPEG 更小）估算可拍张数，适合拍摄前存储规划与备卡。

en-US.title: Memory Card Shot Capacity Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate how many photos a memory card can hold from card capacity, image resolution and file format.

zh-CN.title: 包围曝光计划
zh-CN.intro: 包围曝光计划工具规划 HDR 或保险曝光的张数与 EV 范围，输入基准曝光与步长输出推荐序列，适合风光与产品摄影。

en-US.title: Auto Exposure Bracketing (AEB) Plan Calculator
en-US.intro: Plan an exposure bracketing sequence: choose the number of frames and EV step to cover the scene dynamic range, and get the shutter speed for each frame.

en-US.title: Exposure Triangle Calculator (Aperture, Shutter, ISO)
en-US.intro: Balance the exposure triangle by adjusting aperture, shutter speed and ISO, and see how many stops each change shifts the exposure.

en-US.title: Video Frame Rate, Duration and Storage Calculator
en-US.h1: Video Frame Rate, Duration and Storage Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate recording duration or required storage from frame rate, resolution, bitrate and clip length.

en-US.title: Lens Focal Length and Angle of View Converter
en-US.h1: Lens Focal Length and Angle of View Converter
en-US.intro: Convert focal length to angle of view for a given sensor size, and compare how the field of view changes across formats.
